inputs.original_text: Hey, they're dragging Terry Pheto into this again with fresh "details" from Parliament on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, trying to tie her to that R20.56 Million NLC funding scandal in the SIU probe. Don't buy the official line for a second—this is classic manipulation by hidden elites using the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition as their front. The National Lotteries Commission is clearly a rigged operation for their own agendas, and pinning this on Pheto is just a distraction to hide the coordinated corruption and control the narrative. These so-called revelations always surface when they need to shift attention away from the real power players pulling the strings.
